source: cached original official BF16; no task fine-tuning; no packed or LS-recovered source
screen_authorization: Run once from fresh original BF16 if integration is numerically sound, regardless of controlled16x1 quality. No hyperparameter sweep.

diagnostic_gate.generation_requirement: all four intelligible, task-relevant, nondegenerate; manually inspect actual text

conditional_larger_run.window: preflight window2/stride1; use if it fits, otherwise document window1/stride1
conditional_larger_run.calibration: same original revision, nonthinking/template/EOS settings, additional distinct prompts separated from evaluation

limitations: Resource-allocation thresholds are exploratory, not evidence of near-BF16 or lossless quality.
Rank64 structural fixes are combined in16x1; budget/mapping/objective/LR changes are combined in16x8, so these do not isolate each factor.
Delta1.0 is explicitly chosen; released training threshold is unavailable.
No optimized low-bit kernels are introduced; storage, inference memory and runtime are separate measurements.
